title: Lime Green Account: Your Dedicated Account Manager
summary: This document explains Lime Green Account support procedures: direct messages are answered within 2 business hours, and calls to the priority line have a maximum 6-minute expected wait. It also covers the Lime Green referral program: $200 per successful referral, $150 welcome bonus for the referred business, 12 referrals/year cap, and qualification that the business deposits $15,000 within 90 days; you must have 90 days of Rho-Bank checking status.
faqs: How quickly will my Lime Green Account direct message be answered?
